dataset: SignalOps Google Rapid Agent prepared evidence bundle
summary: Prepared evidence for a Gemini-assisted triage run around privilege-boundary drift in project invites.
geminiPlan: Identify the changed authorization helper and deploy window.
Collect GitLab merge request, CI, and ownership context.
Cross-check policy logs before drafting remediation.
Keep rollback and customer-impact actions behind human approval.

partnerEvidence.detail: Role mapper change touched invite acceptance and billing-scope helpers.
Canary deploy completed 12 minutes before the first high-risk event.
Policy guard failed on invite acceptance for accounts created in the last 24 hours.
Identity team owns accounts-api and can approve rollback.

humanApproval.reason: Rollback and permission changes can affect customer access, so SignalOps keeps execution guarded.

fallbackPolicy.behavior: Preserve partial evidence, reduce confidence, and request analyst confirmation before remediation.
